finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** 380 commits, 13 user-facing.

Three breaking changes hide under `refactor` and `fix` labels. The `v1` export route is gone. Eight commits stopped re-exporting error types from `core`, `db`, `auth`, `jobs`, `billing`. Expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`.

One feature: webhook retry with backoff. Everything else is deps, tests, and CI.

Two calls to check. I put the `401` change under Breaking, though it shipped as a `fix`. I left perf work out, since your template allows only three headings.

`docs: note the minimum node version` never touched `engines`, so I claimed no Node bump.

Next: confirm the `401` placement and the release date.
